from.place: Upstream master declaration AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.CondensedRing.boundedConstructible_tateTwistDerived (#1448, Poincare.lean): the shifted condensed Tate twist is bounded constructible

title: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.CondensedRing.boundedConstructible_tateTwistDerived
statement: Let l be a prime and k a field of characteristic p>0 with p != l (the section variables of Poincare.lean; the lemma itself only uses l). Let X be any scheme and d, n integers. Write Qlb for the condensed ring Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj l, Qlb_X = condensedRingObj Qlb X its pro-etale coefficient ring on X, and Qlb_X(d) = tateTwistDerived X l d the Tate twist of WeilConjectures.TateTwist.ProEtale [def-pur-condensed-tate-twists], an object of the derived category of Qlb_X-module objects. Then the shift Qlb_X(d)[n] satisfies the predicate boundedConstructible (Qlb_X): it lies in the bounded constructible subcategory D^b_c(X)[[Qlb]] [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible]. Note the statement is for an arbitrary scheme X, as upstream states it; if boundedConstructible needs finiteness of X to hold for a rank-one lisse object, that is a defect of the statement to be reported, not repaired by adding hypotheses.
